question: ¿Cuántos ensayos detenidos (terminados o retirados) prueban, en el mismo ensayo, una quimioterapia y una terapia dirigida?

attempts.query:
SELECT count(*)
FROM aact.studies s
WHERE s.overall_status IN ('TERMINATED','WITHDRAWN')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM linking.trial_drug td JOIN linking.drug_class dc ON dc.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
              WHERE td.nct_id = s.nct_id AND dc.class = 'Chemotherapy')
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM linking.trial_drug td JOIN linking.drug_class dc ON dc.chembl_id = td.parent_chembl_id
              WHERE td.nct_id = s.nct_id AND dc.class IN ('KinaseInhibitor','MonoclonalAntibody'))
